summary.text: Thousand year wind willow is a rare wind willow stem used as a Gu refinement material and able to serve in rank five Gu refinement.

claims.text: At an auction, a female Gu Master presents a thousand year wind willow. Wind willow is a rare plant used in refinement as material. It grows only where there is enough wind energy, and Ju Feng mountain’s year-round winds produce large amounts of wind willows. Ordinary wind willows are only decades or centuries old. A thousand year old stem can be used in rank five Gu refinement.

Wind willow has no tree branches, only underground roots and one stem. When the wind blows, that sole stem sways like seaweed underwater. A thousand year wind willow is rarely seen. Even Ju clan, living on Ju Feng mountain for hundreds of years, has only eighteen remaining. The auction stem is coiled up yet exceeds a hundred meters in length, and a refinement master finally obtains it for almost a hundred thousand primeval stones.
